title: Preallocate single-table scan data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when single-table scan paths build data:<table>: scan prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added scan_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Replaced materialized query scan data-prefix construction.
Replaced statistics-driven primary-key range prefix construction.
Replaced key-only stream projection prefix stripping construction.
Replaced full table scan data-prefix construction.

result: Single-table scan data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving scan, cache, range, stream, and vector query behavior.
